title: Diagnostic
description: A quality diagnostic. Structurally a subset of the LSP `Diagnostic`, carrying an extra `source`/`code` so coverage-gap and flaky-test findings can be told apart in the UI.

source.description: Producer of the diagnostic, e.g. `"csp.coverage"` or `"csp.flaky"`.

DiagnosticSeverity.description:
Severity of a quality diagnostic.

Serialized as a lower-case string. The mapping to LSP's numeric `DiagnosticSeverity` is: `error` → 1, `warning` → 2, `information` → 3, `hint` → 4.

Position.description: Zero-based line/character position, identical in shape to LSP `Position`.

character.description: Zero-based character offset within the line (UTF-16 code units, as in LSP).

Range.description: A range between two positions, end-exclusive — identical to LSP `Range`.
